objective: Repair the two defects proven by the aggressive QA suite in block.media.image-prep@0.1.0, then produce a new candidate version for admission.
explicit_prohibitions: do not rewrite the 0.1.0 admission record
do not pretend the defects never existed
do not invent a general version registry

defects.A: Blob type image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8 bypasses rejection because the implementation compares only the exact string image/svg+xml. SVG must reject as unsupported_type even with valid MIME parameters.
defects.B: A 4096x1 raster with longEdge 1200 rounds the short dimension to 0. Every output raster dimension must be >= 1 pixel.

sections.0: PRESERVE 0.1.0 — immutable historical evidence; any repair produces a new version/digest; verify the actual versioning convention before bumping
sections.1: Read only required evidence; do not broaden scope
sections.2: Defect A — smallest standards-correct MIME essence fix + regression coverage for three SVG forms; do not over-reject parameterized raster MIME
sections.3: Defect B — smallest safe dimension floor + boundary coverage for 4096x1, 1x4096, 1x1, exact longEdge, just over longEdge
sections.4: Test-first: prove the new regression tests fail against 0.1.0, then apply the smallest patch; report exact lines changed
sections.5: Run all suites on real LEGION Windows: node, browser, aggressive, new regressions
sections.6: Recompute the digest by the admitted procedure; require new != old; record old/new version and digest; candidate record only if existing V2 law supports it
sections.7: Scope check — prove nothing outside Block #1 changed
sections.8: Commit; push when available; PUSH_PENDING acceptable
